made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/regalos-sheet-make.js, from regalos-set.html (window.REGALOS.E) and the design of Los regalos (the orchestrator's p10-spec, general rules and section regalos). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 74. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the wall at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 74 + 13 v - 22.5 z; the picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62. E.STEP and E.STOOL are arrays [u, v, height] in the set (STEP.u, STEP.v, STEP.h of the spec are E.STEP[0], [1], [2])
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the floor; z 0.46: the bench's seat; z 0.74: the table's top; z 0.3: the step stool's top; z 0.34: the low stool's top; the photos' cord is z 1.95, a photo hangs from z 1.85) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): a thing on a surface has its bottom middle on the spot (the box [sx - floor(w / 2), sy - h, w, h]); a thing that hangs (a photo on the cord) has its top middle on the spot (the box [sx - floor(w / 2), sy, w, h]). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 51 rows drawn standing for a grown-up (rows 4 to 54 of a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty), 41 for a child (rows 2 to 42 of 44); the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51): column 30, rows 0 to 49; a small thing: see spot. The curtain: the sprite is things.cortina.box (or .half), its left column on the box's left column and its bottom edge on the spot's row. Nobody is drawn turned
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
